annotations.title: Vehicle Registration & License Plates | Department of Revenue
County Tag Offices | Department of Revenue

content.text:
It looks like you’re trying to get to the **Georgia Department of Revenue Motor Vehicle Division tag/registration site**.

The old address:

`mvd.dor.ga.gov/tags/index.aspx`

may redirect or no longer work reliably. Use the Georgia DOR’s current vehicle registration page instead:

**Georgia DOR — Vehicle Registration & License Plates:**  
([dor.georgia.gov](https://dor.georgia.gov/motor-vehicles/vehicle-registration-license-plates?utm_source=openai))

You can also go directly to **DRIVES e-Services / MyMVD** from the Georgia DOR site to renew a tag, check registration, or handle other motor vehicle services. Your local **county tag office** is the main resource for most tag, title, and registration questions. ([mvd.dor.ga.gov](https://mvd.dor.ga.gov/motor/tagoffices/selecttagoffice.aspx?utm_source=openai))
